thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/26/2018: IPAS, VIOT, AAPL, ESLT, LOGI

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/26/2018: IPAS, VIOT, AAPL, ESLT, LOGI
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.3%
AAPL: +1.0%
IBM: +1.0%
CSCO: +1.6%
GOOG: +1.6%
Technology shares were higher in pre-market trading on Monday.
Expected movers:
- iPass ( IPAS ) rose more than 6% after signing a seven-figure deal to license the iPass SmartConnect to German telecommunications firm Deutsche Telekom;
- Logitech ( LOGI ) rose nearly 3% after terminating talks to acquire Plantronics ( PLT )
- Apple ( AAPL ) rose 1% after partnering with French luxury goods group Kering to develop a suite of apps to enhance customer service at its brick-and-mortar stores
Other news:
- Elbit Systems ( ESLT ): completed the acquisition of IMI Systems Ltd.
- Viomi Technology (VIOT): reported increased non-GAAP income versus year ago and doubled revenues year over year
